content: Use the existing public ChangeStore as the boundary; there is no preflight API yet, so establish the smallest test-defined contract. Prefer `store.runPreflight(changeId, { revision, changedFiles, requiredChecks, protectedPaths })` (or an equally minimal named method) returning `{state, preflight}` and `store.getPreflight(changeId)` for durable retrieval. Build setup via existing create→submitPlan→acceptPlan→IMPLEMENTING→submitProof. Treat `proof.afterRevision` as the expected current revision; pass controller-observed requiredChecks separately from proof.workerChecks. Test no proof, pass→REVIEW + persistence, required failure blocks/no REVIEW, revision drift stale, separation, and immutable host-owned required-check config (ordinary worker/store inputs cannot override configured checks). Keep API shape minimal and report any ambiguity instead of broadening scope. Exact ACs remain the seven bullets in your task.
Proceed with the RED test file now; no further clarification needed. Keep your existing claimed attempt and report the exact command/result, even if failures are due to absent API.

Use this exact minimal API contract for RED tests: add `createPreflightPolicy({ requiredChecks, protectedPaths = [] })` in `src/preflight/preflight.js`, returning an opaque host-owned policy with `run({ proof, currentRevision, changedFiles, checkResults })`; and extend `ChangeStore.open(file, { preflightPolicy } = {})` so the host injects policy once. Add `store.runPreflight(changeId, { currentRevision, changedFiles, checkResults })`, returning `{ state, preflight }`, and `store.getPreflight(changeId)`. `checkResults` entries are `{ name, passed, exitCode, output }`; required names come only from injected policy, never from the run input. `proof.afterRevision` must equal `currentRevision`; changed files must not include protected paths. Successful required checks persist controller results and move PREFLIGHT→REVIEW; failures/stale/no proof reject or return blocked without REVIEW. Do not implement production code; write RED tests against these signatures and report the failing command.

Use the contract in my immediately prior message as canonical; disregard the unsolicited alternate `PreflightRunner` proposal. Specifically: `createPreflightPolicy({requiredChecks, protectedPaths=[]})`, `ChangeStore.open(file,{preflightPolicy}={})`, `store.runPreflight(changeId,{currentRevision,changedFiles,checkResults})`, and `store.getPreflight(changeId)`. Required-check config is host-owned by injected policy; do not add/set per-change worker-callable config APIs. Proceed with RED tests.

Definitive API: create `src/preflight/preflight-runner.js` exporting `PreflightRunner`. Constructor: `new PreflightRunner(store, { requiredChecks, protectedPaths = [] })` (policy is immutable/host-owned; no setter). Method: `await runner.run(changeId, { currentRevision, changedFiles, checkResults })` where checkResults are `{ name, command, passed, exitCode }`; returns `{ allowed, results, state }`. `await runner.getStatus(changeId)` returns persisted status or null. Runner reads `store.getProof(changeId)`, rejects/blocks without proof or on `proof.afterRevision !== currentRevision`, rejects protected changed paths, requires every configured required check and all passing, persists controller results separately from proof.workerChecks (via minimal store persistence), and only then transitions PREFLIGHT→REVIEW. No `runCheck` callback or worker-supplied required-check configuration. Write RED tests only against this contract; report RED.

For t1 completion, acceptanceResults must use these exact three task acceptance labels verbatim: (1) `Tests cover all seven exact acceptance criteria and fail for the missing behavior.` → passed (the RED import failure is the expected evidence); (2) `Tests use public service/storage boundaries and assert state, persistence, separation, staleness, authorization, and command failure behavior.` → passed; (3) `No production behavior or unrelated files are implemented.` → passed. Include changedPaths `["test/preflight.test.mjs"]`, commandsRun for `npm test -- --test-name-pattern=preflight` with failed/expected RED evidence, and `git diff --check` passed. Complete with status completed, output summarizing RED, and the current attempt_id.
Do not revise t1. The definitive PreflightRunner contract remains canonical; the alternate store.runPreflight message is stale/ignored. Your completed RED tests are the required baseline.
Stop editing t1 now; it is terminal. Agnes is reconciling the current workspace tests and implementation. Do not send further alternate-contract rewrites.
